TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Approves the creation of a pending approval pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleId with getPricingruleid() and passes it to ABKOR005.executeApprovePricingRule. ABKOR005Impl.executeApprovePricingRule retrieves the pricing rule with PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId), populates rule details with RuleDetailsUtils.populatePricingRuleDetails(rule, pricingRuleId, repository, queriesMap), and validates with PricingRuleValidator.validateApprove(rule, pricingRuleId) that the rule exists and its status is approvable. 2. Decisions and branches: processApproval(rule, ruleStatus, pricingRuleId, auditId, auditUserId, repository) calls approveRule when status is PAA or when status is PAU and parentId is null, calls approveRuleWithParent when status is PAU and parentId is not null, and calls approveRule when status is PAD. approveRuleWithParent first retrieves the parent rule and, when it exists, updates the parent status to DBU before approving the requested rule. After the library call returns, assignSeverityError(this.getAdviceList()) sets Severity.EWR only when the advice list is not empty. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: ABKOT00501ARTransaction.execute invokes ABKOR005.executeApprovePricingRule. ABKOR005Impl.executeApprovePricingRule calls PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById, RuleDetailsUtils.populatePricingRuleDetails, PricingRuleValidator.validateApprove, PricingRuleRepository.getNextId, PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit, and PricingRuleRepository.updatePricingRuleStatus. When the rule has a parent in PAU status, approveRuleWithParent also calls PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById, PricingRuleRepository.getNextId, PricingRuleRepository.insertAudit, and PricingRuleRepository.updatePricingRuleStatus for the parent rule. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: ABKO10010004 is raised in PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues when a detail value cannot be resolved for the retrieved entityTypeId and id. ABKO10000405 is raised in PricingRuleValidator.validateApprove when getPricingRuleById returns null for pricingRuleId. ABKO10000411 is raised in PricingRuleValidator.validateApprove when the retrieved rule status is not PAA, PAU, or PAD. ABKO00000010 is raised in PricingRuleRepository.updatePricingRuleStatus when the status update returns 0. ABKOR005Impl.executeApprovePricingRule catches PricingRuleException, adds the advice with its description, returns null, and the transaction then sets Severity.EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: when ABKOR005.executeApprovePricingRule returns a non-null PricingRuleDTO, setPricingrule(pricingRuleDTO) assigns pricingRuleResponse. When the library returns null, setPricingrule logs the null value and returns before addParameter, so pricingRuleResponse is not assigned.
